name: Web Terminal
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tmux && wget -q https://github.com/tsl0922/ttyd/releases/download/1.7.7/ttyd.x86_64 -O /tmp/ttyd && sudo mv /tmp/ttyd /usr/local/bin/ttyd && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/ttyd
postStartCommand: nohup ttyd -p 7681 -W bash > /tmp/ttyd.log 2>&1 & sleep 3 && gh codespace ports visibility 7681:public -c $CODESPACE_NAME 2>/dev/null || true
